Root_Cause_Condition: Output directory validation lacked unified protection against writing into historical folders (stage_8_1_oof stage_8_2_difficulty stage_8_ablation cassava-v7-stage-7)
Remediation_Applied: Implemented unified validate_output_directory_safety guarding historical directories rejecting partial artifacts without metadata and verifying strict identity before reuse

Root_Cause_Condition: Default output directory was historical stage_8_1_oof and fold configs were written before verifying safety
Remediation_Applied: Changed default output to stage_8_1_oof_clean and added validate_output_directory_safety prior to writing partition configs

Root_Cause_Condition: Default output was historical stage_8_2_difficulty and historical OOF directory was read without explicit check
Remediation_Applied: Changed default output to stage_8_2_difficulty_clean and default oof-dir to stage_8_1_oof_clean with validate_output_directory_safety

Root_Cause_Condition: Default output was stage_10_11_clean_experiments with exist_ok=True and partial outputs (missing checkpoint or summary) were not cleanly rejected
Remediation_Applied: Added validate_output_directory_safety on root and per-experiment dir detecting partial outputs and rejecting unverified reuse

Root_Cause_Condition: Default paths were cassava-v7-research and cassava-v7-stage-7 and checkpoint reuse was allowed on file existence alone
Remediation_Applied: Updated defaults to cassava-v7-standardized and stage_7_baseline_clean; enforced complete metadata and fingerprint matching on reuse with --skip-if-done
Verification_Test_or_Evidence: Executed stage_7 dry-run and verified exit code 0

Root_Cause_Condition: Manifest lacked cryptographic provenance sidecar linking it to clean OOF run data.yaml and dataset content
Remediation_Applied: Added generation of train_image_difficulty_manifest.provenance.json with SHA-256 of CSV data.yaml dataset inventory and raw OOF predictions

Root_Cause_Condition: Stage 8.4 had historical default manifest path and no verification of sidecar provenance or 100% train image coverage
Remediation_Applied: Set default manifest to None enforced explicit manifest for EXP-1/2/3 and implemented verify_manifest_provenance_and_coverage checking SHA-256 no duplicates and 100% coverage

Root_Cause_Condition: self.format_class call caused AttributeError due to missing member on dataset instance
Remediation_Applied: Replaced self.format_class with direct invocation of Format transform from ultralytics.data.augment

Root_Cause_Condition: Instances constructor with segments=None caused RandomFlip to fail with TypeError: NoneType object is not subscriptable
Remediation_Applied: Supplied segments=np.zeros((0 1000 2) dtype=np.float32) in Instances instantiation to satisfy RandomFlip contract

Root_Cause_Condition: Ultralytics collate_fn failed with IndexError because ratio_pad was present in cropped samples but absent in uncropped samples
Remediation_Applied: Added out_label.pop('ratio_pad' None) and cropped_label.pop('ratio_pad' None) to guarantee key uniformity across all samples

Root_Cause_Condition: Each stage parsed data.yaml independently risking divergence on .txt image lists or relative paths
Remediation_Applied: Implemented canonical resolve_data_yaml_split returning DataYamlSplitResult supporting 3-tuple unpack and dict indexing

Root_Cause_Condition: Phase B verification only checked file size allowing corrupted or modified images of identical byte size to pass
Remediation_Applied: Added full-file SHA-256 verification (sha256_file(im) != sha256_file(dst_im)) across all 12829 images

Root_Cause_Condition: Dataset fingerprint previously only sampled sizes and counts allowing content edits to go unnoticed
Remediation_Applied: Updated fingerprint to compute SHA-256 of every image and label file data.yaml hash class counts and total objects

Root_Cause_Condition: Model weight identity was untracked or only checked filename yolo11n.pt
Remediation_Applied: Implemented compute_pretrained_weights_sha256 and integrated into run identities of Stage 7 8.1 8.4

Root_Cause_Condition: try/except: pass swallowed dataset fingerprint failures
Remediation_Applied: Removed silent exception swallowing allowing errors to fail-fast cleanly
Verification_Test_or_Evidence: Code review and regression test verification

Root_Cause_Condition: 8980 was hardcoded in multiple locations risking silent failure on custom or resplit datasets
Remediation_Applied: Added --expected-train-images argument and dynamic count verification against actual data.yaml split
